basis: Axes an author answered N/A in every measured action of the shape (AI-Gomoku rev 39 and 48 agent-written actions of the 2026-10-31 FREEZE A/B, states expanded first), kept only where the mechanism of the shape explains the N/A. v1 implied undo on navigate and browse; authors answered undo both ways (6/12, 14/24), so it is written by hand now.

navigate.meaning: Leaves for another screen or area at once: no input to check, no request that can fail, nothing confirmed or changed.

browse.meaning: Changes what the current screen shows (a step, page, filter or position) and may compute or load for it; nothing is changed.

local_choice.meaning: Picks a value on the current screen; no request leaves the device until a later submit.

discard.meaning: Confirms, then throws local state away and leaves (new game, clear, sign out): no input to check, no request that can fail, nothing to undo.

toggle.meaning: Flips one reversible flag in place, such as a favourite; flipping it back is its undo.

submit.meaning: Commits input or starts work whose result the user waits for; every axis applies.

destructive.meaning: Removes or irreversibly changes something; every axis applies.
